name: Killing
overview: Scripture clearly upholds the sanctity of human life, commanding 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13; Deuteronomy 5:17) while distinguishing the gravity of taking innocent life (Exodus 23:7) and declaring that God will require a reckoning for the shedding of blood (Genesis 9:5). Jesus reiterates this command in Matthew 5:21, warning that those who kill face judgment. However, Romans 13:4 teaches that God ordains authorities to wield the sword justly, implying a divine allowance for killing in contexts such as self-defense or war, always under God's righteous judgment.
